page.notes: Printed text is clipped at the bottom; this is part 1 of 2. Running head "Cap.6" at the top right is a chapter number and is not included in running_head. Marginal notes beside the upper lines are both included. Reference marks are asterisks in the text and in the notes. The Greek phrase after "atque" is only partly legible; the Greek word is marked [?] and its letters are uncertain. The marginal letters a, b and c are reference marks; the Greek word in the text is a best reading. Catchword "copi" completes the word "Episcopi" with the printed hyphen on "Episc-".
